h1: Custom Pink Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom pink badges for your team. Ideal for breast cancer awareness or retail staff. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Pink badges stand out in retail, healthcare, and event settings where a soft, approachable color helps identify staff or volunteers. Whether you need custom pink name badges for a breast cancer awareness campaign or pink security badges for a conference, our imprinting options include full-color dye sublimation or crisp screen printing on durable plastic or metal substrates. Choose from standard 3" x 1" rectangles, round pin buttons, or magnetic backing for easy daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom pink badges with white text and logo, pinned to a lanyard, for employee identification
